status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Now
segments.note: 「Now」は Ἐγένετο δὲ

segments.t: on the second Sabbath after the first,
segments.note: 「second … after the first」は WEB が従う異読 δευτεροπρώτῳ の訳。ギリシャ語本文は ἐν σαββάτῳ のみ

segments.t: he was going through the grain fields.
segments.note: 「he was going」は διαπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν

segments.t: His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
segments.note: 「and ate, rubbing them in their hands」は καὶ ἤσθιον τοὺς στάχυας ψώχοντες ταῖς χερσίν。「them / their」は英語の補い

segments.t: But some of the Pharisees said to them,
segments.note: 「to them」は英語の補い。δὲ（2番）は「But」

segments.t: “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
Jesus, answering them, said,
“Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry,
segments.note: 「Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry」は Οὐδὲ τοῦτο ἀνέγνωτε ὃ ἐποίησεν Δαυὶδ ὁπότε ἐπείνασεν αὐτὸς

segments.t: he and those who were with him,
how he entered into God’s house,
segments.note: 「how」は ὡς

segments.t: and took and ate the show bread,
and gave also to those who were with him,
which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Κύριός ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου

segments.t: It also happened on another Sabbath
segments.note: 「also」は文脈の補い

segments.t: that he entered into the synagogue and taught.
There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
The scribes and the Pharisees watched him,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： παρετηροῦντο οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath,
segments.note: 「to see whether he would heal」は εἰ ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεύει

segments.t: that they might find an accusation against him.
segments.note: 「an accusation against him」は κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ

segments.t: But he knew their thoughts;
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ

segments.t: and he said to the man who had the withered hand,
segments.note: 「who had the withered hand」は τῷ ξηρὰν ἔχοντι τὴν χεῖρα

segments.t: “Rise up and stand in the middle.”
He arose and stood.
Then Jesus said to them,
segments.note: 「Then」は δὲ

segments.t: “I will ask you something:
segments.note: 「something」は次の質問内容を指す英語の補い

segments.t: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm?
segments.note: 「Is it lawful」は εἰ ἔξεστιν

segments.t: To save a life, or to kill?”
segments.note: 「kill」は ἀπολέσαι（滅ぼす）の意訳

segments.t: He looked around at them all,
segments.note: 「He looked around at them all」は καὶ περιβλεψάμενος πάντας αὐτοὺς

segments.t: and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.”
He did, and his hand was restored
segments.note: 「He did」は ὁ δὲ ἐποίησεν

segments.t: as sound as the other.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「as sound as the other」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： αὐτοὶ δὲ ἐπλήσθησαν ἀνοίας καὶ διελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους τί ἂν ποιήσαιεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ。「rage」は ἀνοίας（分別なさ）の意訳

segments.t: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray,
segments.note: 「In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray」は Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι の意訳

segments.t: and he continued all night in prayer to God.
segments.note: 「continued all night」は διανυκτερεύων

segments.t: When it was day,
segments.note: 「When it was day」は καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡμέρα。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
Simon, whom he also named Peter;
Andrew, his brother;
James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
Matthew; Thomas;
segments.note: 各 καὶ は区切りの「;」に対応

segments.t: James the son of Alphaeus;
segments.note: 「the son of Alphaeus」は Ἁλφαίου（アルファイの［子］）。「son」は英語の補い

segments.t: Simon who was called the Zealot;
Judas the son of James;
segments.note: 「the son of James」は Ἰακώβου（ヤコブの［子］）。各 καὶ は区切りの「;」に対応

segments.t: and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
segments.note: 「also」は英語の補い

segments.t: He came down with them and stood on a level place,
with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon,
segments.note: 「with」は文脈の接続

segments.t: who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
segments.note: 節境界のずれ：この句はギリシャ語本文では18節冒頭（οἳ ἦλθον ἀκοῦσαι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰαθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν νόσων αὐτῶν）。当該トークンは18節側で未対応のまま残る

segments.t: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits;
segments.note: 「as well as」は καὶ。17節へずれた冒頭部（トークン1–10）は未対応

segments.t: and they were being healed.
All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἐζήτουν ἅπτεσθαι αὐτοῦ ὅτι δύναμις παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐξήρχετο καὶ ἰᾶτο πάντας

segments.t: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said:
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Blessed are you who are poor,
segments.note: 「are you」は英語の補い（原文は Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοί）

segments.t: for God’s Kingdom is yours.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ὅτι ὑμετέρα ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ

segments.t: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled.
segments.note: 「are you / will be」は英語の補い（原文は μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες νῦν ὅτι χορτασθήσεσθε）

segments.t: Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil,
segments.note: 句全体の対応。「are」は ἐστε

segments.t: for the Son of Man’s sake.
Rejoice in that day and leap for joy,
segments.note: 「leap for joy」は σκιρτήσατε

segments.t: for behold, your reward is great in heaven,
segments.note: 「for behold」は ἰδοὺ γὰρ。「is」は英語の補い

segments.t: for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς προφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν

segments.t: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： πλὴν οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς πλουσίοις ὅτι ἀπέχετε τὴν παράκλησιν ὑμῶν。「are」は英語の補い

segments.t: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry.
segments.note: 「are」は英語の補い

segments.t: Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
Woe, when men speak well of you,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： Οὐαὶ ὅταν καλῶς ὑμᾶς εἴπωσιν πάντες οἱ ἄνθρωποι

segments.t: for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς ψευδοπροφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν

segments.t: “But I tell you who hear:
segments.note: 「I」は λέγω の主語

segments.t: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς καταρωμένους ὑμᾶς προσεύχεσθε περὶ τῶν ἐπηρεαζόντων ὑμᾶς。「and」は文脈の接続

segments.t: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other;
segments.note: 句全体の対応： τῷ τύπτοντί σε ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα πάρεχε καὶ τὴν ἄλλην

segments.t: and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
Give to everyone who asks you,
and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
segments.note: 「to give them back again」は μὴ ἀπαίτει（取り戻すな）の意訳的展開

segments.t: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ καθὼς θέλετε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς ὁμοίως。「exactly so」は ὁμοίως

segments.t: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you?
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: For even sinners love those who love them.
If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you?
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: For even sinners do the same.
If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you?
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
segments.note: 「back as much」は ἀπολάβωσιν τὰ ἴσα

segments.t: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back;
segments.note: 「But」は πλὴν

segments.t: and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High;
segments.note: 「and」は καὶ

segments.t: for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
“Therefore be merciful,
segments.note: 「Therefore」は文脈の接続で γίνεσθε に同乗

segments.t: even as your Father is also merciful.
segments.note: 「even as」は καθὼς。「also」は英語の補い

segments.t: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
segments.note: 句全体の対応。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Give, and it will be given to you:
segments.note: 「it」は δοθήσεται の形式主語

segments.t: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you.
segments.note: 「will be given」は δώσουσιν（彼らが与える）の受動的意訳

segments.t: For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
segments.note: 「same」は英語の補い

segments.t: He spoke a parable to them.
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない。「also」は καὶ

segments.t: “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
A disciple is not above his teacher,
segments.note: 「A」は英語の補い

segments.t: but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
segments.note: 「when he is」は κατηρτισμένος の時間的展開

segments.t: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye,
segments.note: 「Why」は τί。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’
segments.note: 「Or」は文脈の接続。「let me remove」は ἄφες ἐκβάλω

segments.t: when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye?
segments.note: 「when」は αὐτὸς … οὐ βλέπων の状況表現

segments.t: You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye,
and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
segments.note: 「can see clearly to remove」は διαβλέψεις … ἐκβαλεῖν

segments.t: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit,
segments.note: 「there is」は ἐστιν

segments.t: nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
For each tree is known by its own fruit.
For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
segments.note: 「people」は συλλέγουσιν の不特定主語

segments.t: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good,
segments.note: 「out of」は ἐκ。「that which is good」は τὸ ἀγαθόν

segments.t: and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil,
segments.note: 「treasure」（2度目）は前出 θησαυροῦ の補い。原文2度目は τοῦ πονηροῦ のみ

segments.t: for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
“Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
segments.note: 句全体の対応： Τί δέ με καλεῖτε Κύριε κύριε καὶ οὐ ποιεῖτε ἃ λέγω。「the things which」は ἃ

segments.t: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them,
I will show you who he is like.
He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock.
segments.note: 「went deep」は ἐβάθυνεν

segments.t: When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it,
segments.note: 「When a flood arose」は πλημμύρης δὲ γενομένης

segments.t: because it was founded on the rock.
segments.note: 「founded on the rock」は WEB が従う異読（τεθεμελίωτο ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν）の訳。ギリシャ語本文は διὰ τὸ καλῶς οἰκοδομῆσθαι αὐτήν（よく建てられていたから）

segments.t: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation,
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ

segments.t: against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell;
segments.note: 「against which」は ᾗ

segments.t: and the ruin of that house was great.”
